keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the topic (Jenner had made the first vaccine) and the conclusion (vaccines train our bodies to fight germs). The green sentences are the answers.

qs.q: Why can the body react quickly to a real germ after a vaccine?
qs.qko: 백신을 맞은 몸이 진짜 병균에 빠르게 반응할 수 있는 이유는 무엇인가요?
opts: Because the immune system practiced fighting a harmless version and remembers it
Because the vaccine kills every germ in the world
Because cows give us strong milk
evs: A vaccine lets our immune system practice fighting a harmless version of a germ and remember it, so the body can react quickly to the real germ.
Many of them had already caught cowpox, a mild disease from cows.
Jenner had made the first vaccine, and the word comes from vacca, the Latin word for cow!
Thanks to vaccines, smallpox was completely wiped out from the world.
why: 백신 덕분에 면역 체계가 해롭지 않은 병균과 싸우는 연습을 하고 그것을 기억하기 때문에, 진짜 병균에 빠르게 반응할 수 있다고 했어요.
A vaccine lets the immune system practice fighting a harmless version of a germ and remember it, so the body reacts quickly to the real germ.

qs.q: In "smallpox was completely wiped out from the world," what does "wiped out" mean?
qs.qko: «smallpox was completely wiped out from the world» 에서 «wiped out» 은 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: Thanks to vaccines, smallpox was completely wiped out from the world.
In the 1700s, a terrible disease called smallpox killed millions of people.
Later, the boy was exposed to smallpox, but he did not get sick.
People said that milkmaids, the women who milked cows, rarely caught smallpox.
why: «completely(완전히)» 와 함께 쓰였고, 백신 덕분에 생긴 좋은 결과예요. 그러니 «wiped out» 은 «완전히 없어지다» 라는 뜻이에요.
It is used with «completely», and it is a good result of vaccines, so «wiped out» means completely gone.

qs.q: Why did Jenner think cowpox could protect people from smallpox?
qs.qko: 제너는 왜 우두가 천연두를 막아 줄 수 있다고 생각했나요?
opts: Milkmaids rarely caught smallpox, and many of them had already caught cowpox
Cows never get sick from any disease
A boy told him that cowpox was a deadly disease
evs: People said that milkmaids, the women who milked cows, rarely caught smallpox.
In the 1700s, a terrible disease called smallpox killed millions of people.
Many of them had already caught cowpox, a mild disease from cows.
Vaccines train our bodies to fight germs before they can make us seriously ill.
why: 우유 짜는 여자들은 천연두에 거의 걸리지 않았는데, 그들 대부분이 이미 우두를 앓았다고 했어요. 두 사실을 이어서 제너는 우두가 천연두를 막아 줄 수 있다고 생각했어요.
Milkmaids rarely caught smallpox, and many of them had already caught cowpox. Connecting these two facts gave Jenner his idea.

ends: How do scientists make new vaccines today?

How does our immune system fight germs every day?
